protocol.source: Saved complete ROC results and optional completed FP32-score diagnostics; no model execution by this CLI.
protocol.fa: False-positive pixels divided by all test image pixels; fractions, not percentages.
protocol.pd: Detected target components divided by target components; fractions.
protocol.budget_best: Highest Pd among measured points with Fa <= requested budget; may use a lower Fa.
protocol.linear_estimate: Descriptive interpolation only, not a measured point or inferred threshold.
protocol.outside_range: Unavailable at target; no extrapolation or added (0,0)/(1,1) endpoints.
protocol.exact_matched_fa: Separate real-score budget-optimal threshold measurements; achieved Fa can be below budget. Original 27-point arrays remain unchanged.
protocol.comparison_limit: Retrospective test-set operating-point analysis: exact same-Fa statistics search test-score thresholds under a false-pixel budget. This is not held-out validation.
